subject: Scheduling: Xavier Chen — condensed 6-stage loop & debrief owner

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed condensed 6-stage loop for Software Infra (SWE-Infra)

Hi Xavier — great to meet you over email and thanks for sharing availability via Nora. We like your background and would love to run a compact, 6-stage virtual loop next week to keep momentum.

Quick proposal (all West coast times; total candidate time ~3.5 hrs including breaks):
- Stage 1 (Hiring manager screen): 45m — Laura Bennett — technical/product fit
- Stage 2 (System design): 45m — Logan Wright
- 15m break
- Stage 3 (Deep dive: sequence/ops): 40m — Engineering lead (TBD)
- Stage 4 (Coding exercise — pair): 45m — interviewer panel
- Stage 5 (Culture + compensation brief): 20m — People Ops (recording)
- Stage 6 (Debrief sync w/LAURA as single-point): 10m — immediate debrief handshake

Proposed slots (pick one):
- Tue 2026-09-14, 9:00AM–12:30PM PT
- Wed 2026-09-15, 11:00AM–2:30PM PT

Attached: role_brief.pdf (high-level loop expectations). If those windows don't work share your preference and timezone and we can expand.

Next steps: if you confirm a slot we’ll send calendar invites to the panel with a short prep doc + candidate resume.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: role_brief.pdf

Subject: Fwd: Xavier Chen — confirm Wed 9/15 11:00 PT + panel sequence + debrief ownership

Laura / Logan — forwarding confirmed slot from Xavier (he picked Wed 9/15 11:00 PT). Below are two requests where I need quick alignment so we can lock invites:

1) Panel sequencing + pacing: given the condensed nature we want the system design (Stage 2) before the break and the deep ops dive after. That helps flow from broad->narrow. Proposed internal timing (start times PT):
- 11:00–11:45 Stage 1: Hiring manager — Laura
- 11:45–12:30 Stage 2: System design — Logan
- 12:30–12:45 Break (candidate buffer + notes)
- 12:45–1:25 Stage 3: Deep dive (ops) — Alex or Priya (I’m confirming)
- 1:25–2:10 Stage 4: Pair coding (shared link) — Panel (we'll split into two 22m blocks)
- 2:10–2:30 Stage 5: Culture + comp — People Ops (recorded)
- 2:30–2:40 Stage 6: Immediate debrief — Laura to capture consensus

2) Debrief owner: Laura, can you take the single-point debrief (10–15 min) right after the loop? We want one person to synthesize feedback in Green/Amber/Red and ping hiring manager + recruiter within 30m. If you can’t, Logan — can you cover?

Attachments: Xavier_Chen_Resume.pdf for reference. Also adding a drive link with a short interviewer prep doc. I’ll send calendar invites once we confirm debrief owner and the ops interviewer (Alex/Priya).

Thanks — quick replies appreciated so Nora/Xavier see invites today.

Chloe
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Xavier_Chen_Resume.pdf
Related link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cInterviewRunbook

Thanks Chloe — Wed 11:00 PT works for me. I can take System Design (11:45–12:30) as proposed.

Laura — happy to flex the deep ops slot if Alex can't make it; I can cover Stage 3 (12:45–1:25) as well but would prefer to keep the pair-coding panel separate to ensure we have two interviewers for the exercise. If Laura can take the debrief, that would be ideal.

I'll stand up the pairing repo and share the Google Meet link after invites go out (I'll drop it in the event description).

Logan
Staff Engineer (Infra) — Redwood Inference
